name.ja: Figure-rise Standard Amplified -三幻神降臨- ラーの翼神竜
name.en: Figure-rise Standard Amplified -Three Genshins Advent- The Winged Dragon of Ra

description.ja: キャラクターの魅力をオリジナルアレンジで“増幅”！『遊☆戯☆王デュエルモンスターズ』より、三幻神の一体「ラーの翼神竜」がAmplifiedに降臨!!
description.en: “Amplify” the charm of the characters with original arrangements! From "Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters ", " The Winged Dragon of Ra", one of the three phantom gods, has arrived in Amplified!!

description.ja: • 翼を前面に展開することで、Amplified解釈の球体形（スフィア・モード）を再現。
description.en: • By deploying the wings to the front, the spherical shape (sphere mode) of the Amplified interpretation is reproduced.

description.ja: • 額の宝玉や舌などを洗練されたパーツ分割で表現。設定をイメージした緻密な色分けを実現。
description.en: • Represent the jewel on the forehead and the tongue with sophisticated parts division. Achieves detailed color coding based on the image of the setting.

description.ja: • 2色のゴールドパーツの使い分けでディテールを再現。
description.en: • Detail is reproduced by using two different colors of gold parts.

description.ja: • 細かく可動部分を設け、柔軟な可動を実現。口の開閉、舌の可動が可能。
description.en: • Finely movable parts are provided to achieve flexible movement. It is possible to open and close the mouth and move the tongue.

description.ja: • 翼の全幅約400mmで迫力のある飛翔姿を再現。
description.en: • The total width of the wings is approximately 400mm, reproducing an impressive flight appearance.

description.ja: • ディスプレイベースと2種類のディスプレイベース用ジョイントパーツが付属。
description.en: • A display base and two types of display base joint parts are included.

accessories.ja: ディスプレイベース×1式
ディスプレイ用ジョイントパーツ×2種
accessories.en: Joint parts for display x 2 types
